answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. No Giltbound parchment stretcher watermark licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence parchment stretchers file after press room hearings is why it holds. Before the stamp comes 50 separate visits, each one billed $9 at the door, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The clerk notes beacon. ferrous is written on the receipt. cipher stays on the record.
